about_the_game:
The introductory chapter of a non-linear detective adventure. Analyse documents to investigate the mysterious disappearance of a successful CEO. Examine evidence, connect clues, and make your own deductions to figure out the identities of her family members.

Zoolingo is a seemingly successful startup company aiming to build a translation app that allows people to understand their pets. After landing an enormous amount of investor funding, the CEO has disappeared under suspicious circumstances. Using documents from her home office, piece together the identities of her family members.

Features:

  • Non-linear gameplay

    • Progression is in your mind! Explore evidence however you want. Connect clues and form your own theories with no hand-holding

  • Cute pets

    • Deduce the identity of the CEO's adorable animal companion!

content_descriptors.notes: Crime is mentioned, including murder and fraud, but there is no visual depiction or detailed description. There is an illustration of a topless man.
